s10.old: - THREE INTEGRATION DEFECTS the per-lane unit tests could not see: D1 Save view 400 - E-client sends `source` as a STRING (`viewSourceLabel()`, `chart-studio.js:1803/1849`) while E-server demands a dict (`server.py:918-920`), so no view ever reached disk; D2 briefing provenance - `currentChart()` (`chart-studio.js:1739`) sends `source`/`provenance` as strings, `server.py:988-989` replaces non-dicts with `{}`, and `chart-briefing.js:325/:430` then prints "[object Obje" as the SHA in every .pptx and HTML bundle (the Graph view … wording: rows 85/86 got a leading "the Graph view …"); D5 `POST /api/restart` answers `{"restarting":true}` even when the console is current (the launcher correctly reuses it, the page polls 2 min then tells the reader to close the tab). Also D6: the reconciliation strip needs `#graph-run`, which is empty until the Graph view has rendered once (`chart-studio.js:2194`), and D3: `test_publish_pocket.py:239-240` leaks a worker into the next test. Fix lane dispatched ~16:45 (one architect, backups `.bak-20260914-fix1`, own writable console 8824).

s10.old: - PARALLEL-LANE CONTRACT TRAP (2026-09-14): two architects built the client and server halves of one feature from one written API contract, each side's tests passed against its own reading (string vs dict for `source`/`provenance`), and only a live run of the real page against a writable console exposed the mismatch. Rule: when a feature is split across lanes, the contract must carry example payloads (not prose), one lane owns the shared fixture both suites import, and the lane is not "done" until a real-client integration pass on a writable instance has run every write path (save, export, publish), not just reads. See `verify-dont-infer-completion-2026-08-04`.

s10.old: - **`git update-index --force-remove` is the WRONG index rollback** - it marks the path deleted vs HEAD. Correct: capture HEAD's blob+mode first, roll back with `git update-index --cacheinfo <mode>,<HEAD sha>,<path>`. Also: `... | Select-Object -First 1` on a native command poisons `$LASTEXITCODE` (terminates the pipeline), which aborted a staging script mid-flight. See [[2026-09-troubleshooting-mentat-repo-state-and-workbooks]].
s10.why: "See [[2026-09-troubleshooting-mentat-repo-state-and-workbooks]]" names another note
